clips.speaker: Beth Wong
clips.title: 被忽视的中国科技：正在苏醒，本土巨头崛起，估值合理成长可期？
title_lines: 正在苏醒，本土巨头崛起

subtitles.en: I mean, there's a lot of attention on Korea and Taiwan for the first half of the year, but actually China has been neglected for a very long time, like what we call like a sleeping giant, right?
subtitles.zh: 上半年市场聚焦韩国和台湾，但中国其实被忽视了很久，就像我们说的“沉睡的巨人”。

subtitles.en: So the domestication of the technology is really happening, so there's a lot of domestic champions going on. China's top policy agenda is obviously on innovation of which technology, it's a very big focus.
subtitles.zh: 技术本土化正在发生，涌现出许多本土领军企业。中国的首要政策议程是创新，其中科技是重中之重。

subtitles.en: So we think there are so many opportunities in Asia and China specifically, that valuation is still relatively reasonable and there's a lot of structural earnings growth opportunities there.
subtitles.zh: 我们认为亚洲尤其是中国机会众多，估值仍相对合理，且存在大量结构性盈利增长机会。

subtitles.en: So some of the areas that we're seeing that have interest, of course, but then tech, that's something that we're still favorable on. Some of the data's on a place, some of the cloud plays.
subtitles.zh: 我们看到一些感兴趣的领域，当然科技仍然是我们看好的方向，比如数据和云相关领域。

subtitles.en: Of course, like the China's open-source weight models continue to be interesting, but beyond that, like just some of the industrial plays that we're seeing in China, whether it's, of course, like human art robots, a lot of headlines recently, and that's going to be market share shifts within that space, but so China is like 50 percent of the global market share in terms of human art robots.
subtitles.zh: 当然，中国的开源权重模型依然有趣，但除此之外，我们看到中国的一些工业领域，比如最近备受关注的人形机器人，市场份额正在发生变化。中国在全球人形机器人市场中占据约50%的份额。

subtitles.en: So from that point of view, we're still positive. So a lot of interesting stories here that we could tap into.
subtitles.zh: 从这个角度看，我们仍然持积极态度。这里有很多有趣的故事可以挖掘。

clips.title: 汇丰资管Beth Wong：如何甄选中国科技赢家？成本与技术双领先
title_lines: 如何甄选中国科技赢家？

subtitles.en: I think, first of all, the market share, it's a very big, determining factor, being like a leader in terms of having the ability to source lower cost inputs are definitely key.
subtitles.zh: 首先，市场份额是一个很大的决定因素，作为领导者，能够获取更低成本的投入品绝对是关键。

subtitles.en: Of course, like the technology leadership, it's very important. So I think the performance per cost factor, it's also very important as well.
subtitles.zh: 当然，技术领先非常重要。我认为性价比因素也非常重要。

subtitles.en: So I would say the ability to develop in-house first-in-class technology, along with market share leadership, to be able to source lower cost inputs would be quite key.
subtitles.zh: 所以我认为，具备自主研发一流技术的能力，加上市场份额领先，并能获取低成本投入，这相当关键。

clips.speaker_context: Asia Equity Senior Investment Specialist at HSBC Asset Management

clips.speaker: Beth Wong
clips.title: 汇丰资管Beth Wong：AI融资潮后，关注回报路径而非资本规模
title_lines: 关注回报路径而非资本规模

subtitles.en: I think within the AI space, you shouldn't see a lot of fundraising, whether it's in the credit space and now in the equity space. And I think that really changes, and what we have seen since July, is that change in market narrative of the market, just not necessarily focusing on building AI, but also what companies would be able to be very disciplined in terms of having that monetization roadmap and having that return on investment roadmap in terms of the investment that they have built on.
subtitles.zh: 我认为在AI领域，你会看到大量融资，无论是在信贷领域还是现在的权益领域。自7月以来，市场叙事发生了变化，不再仅仅关注建设AI，还关注公司是否有纪律性地规划变现路径和回报路径。

subtitles.en: So this, I think, for us investors, would be very focusing on rather than just how much capital there is, how much money that companies are investing on AI.
subtitles.zh: 所以对我们来说，重点不是资本有多少，而是公司投入了多少资金在AI上。

subtitles.en: You know, a big question now with more choices in the AI story, whether that's to your point. There's a broadening out that there are more names now to consider. Where do we get that allocation? In other words, on average, let's say, an average investor profile, what is the appropriate exposure to AI and AI adjacent sectors? How much is too much?
subtitles.zh: 现在AI故事有了更多选择，范围扩大，有更多标的可以考虑。我们该如何配置？对于普通投资者，AI及相邻行业的合适敞口是多少？多少算过多？

clips.speaker_context: Asia Equity Senior Investment Specialist at HSBC Asset Management

clips.speaker: Beth Wong
clips.title: 汇丰资管Beth Wong：中国医疗保健被忽视，生物科技成新亮点

subtitles.en: I mean, we're overweight on China, but as I said before, it's not just on tech. So one of the areas we think that is really getting quite interesting and has been neglected for the first half of the year is in the Chinese healthcare sector, especially on biotech.
subtitles.zh: 我们超配中国，但不仅仅是科技。我们认为上半年被忽视的一个领域是中国医疗保健，尤其是生物科技。

subtitles.en: I think just to put things in context, I think China has really evolved from the last few years to being like a low-cost research hub to really partnering with MNCs in terms of drug development and drug manufacturing.
subtitles.zh: 中国在过去几年已经从低成本研发中心转变为与跨国公司在药物研发和生产方面合作。

subtitles.en: So this is a very clear trend that we're seeing. And in our portfolios, we're, you know, for example, positive in some of the Chinese CDM players.
subtitles.zh: 这是我们看到的明显趋势。在我们的组合中，例如，我们对一些中国CDM企业持积极态度。

clips.speaker_context: Asia Equity Senior Investment Specialist at HSBC Asset Management

clips.speaker: Beth Wong
clips.title: 汇丰资管Beth Wong：印度是“反AI交易”，外资回流带来结构性机会
title_lines: 外资回流带来结构性机会

subtitles.en: I think, you know, when everything everyone's talking about AI and a potentially crowded AI trade, India is basically like an anti-AI trade because, of course, like the exposure to AI is a little bit smaller than some of the North Asia friends that, you know, within the region.
subtitles.zh: 当所有人都在谈论AI和可能拥挤的AI交易时，印度基本上是一个“反AI交易”，因为其对AI的敞口比区域内一些北亚市场要小。

subtitles.en: But there's a lot of structural opportunities there. So I think, you know, whether it's on consumption, whether it's a favorable demographics in terms of actually very strong growth and car growth, car sales growth and two-weaters growth.
subtitles.zh: 但那里有很多结构性机会。无论是消费，还是有利的人口结构，比如强劲的增长、汽车销量增长和两轮车增长。

subtitles.en: So like, you know, the consumption, but we're actually quite, you know, positive on the financial sectors that we're actually quite positive on.
subtitles.zh: 所以消费方面，我们实际上对金融板块相当积极。

subtitles.en: And actually from a flow perspective, like foreign institutions are actually coming back to India since mid of June. So like July is the first month that we're actually seeing foreign flows coming through. And of course, foreign ownership is still at a 20-year low.
subtitles.zh: 从资金流角度看，外国机构自6月中旬以来实际上正在回流印度。7月是我们看到外资流入的第一个月。当然，外资持股仍处于20年低位。

subtitles.en: So from that perspective, light positioning not crowded allows structural opportunities. And within that, we're overweight on the customer discretionary and the financial space.
subtitles.zh: 从这个角度看，仓位不拥挤，提供了结构性机会。其中，我们超配可选消费和金融领域。

clips.speaker: Robert Leib
clips.title: 彭博智库：阿里重金投入AI，回报承压引发市场疑虑

subtitles.en: Well, to carry on with the meteorological theme of depression has entered over the China tech sector, and that's been apparent since Tencent reported, and sort of disappointed expectations, the same with Baidu and now Alibaba.
subtitles.zh: 延续天气比喻，中国科技板块情绪低迷，自腾讯财报不及预期以来一直如此，百度、阿里也类似。

subtitles.en: Because I think, you know, whilst Alibaba certainly has a very clear strategy, they talk a good story, this is coming at a very high financial cost to their business.
subtitles.zh: 阿里战略清晰，故事讲得好，但代价高昂。

subtitles.en: When they reported results last week, we saw their capex spending went up more than two times sequentially to $10 billion in one quarter alone.
subtitles.zh: 上周财报显示，资本开支环比增长超两倍，单季达100亿美元。

subtitles.en: Now, US viewers will no doubt be thinking, well, that's a fraction of what their US counterparts are spending. That's true, but from a very relative low base, it is coming up at a rapid rate, and therefore pressuring their free cash flow.
subtitles.zh: 美国观众会觉得这只是美国同行的一小部分，但基数低、增速快，对自由现金流形成压力。

subtitles.en: If you looked at the change in operating profit for that key cloud intelligence business, the change in operating profit year over year, profit in that business went up by $420 million USD. So that's their return at a massive financial cost and investment cost.
subtitles.zh: 云智能业务营业利润同比增加4.2亿美元，但这是以巨大财务投入为代价的回报。

subtitles.en: So if you look at the year as a whole, they're clearly going to be spending close to 40 billion on capex this year, and as I said, their quarterly profit is only increased by a fraction of that.
subtitles.zh: 全年资本开支将接近400亿美元，而季度利润增幅只是其中一小部分。

subtitles.en: So the ROI really isn't there, and I think what's shot the market is now coming to the market with replacement. Obviously, there's a dilution. It raises questions.
subtitles.zh: 投入产出比不佳，市场担忧稀释，引发疑问。

clips.speaker: Robert Leib
clips.title: 阿里自由现金流转负：为何发股，不发债？

subtitles.en: I think Alibaba does have balance sheet strength. It has, you know, or previously, had a strong free cash flow generation.
subtitles.zh: 阿里资产负债表稳健，此前自由现金流强劲。

subtitles.en: But again, on the back of several results now, including last week, free cash flow generation has gone negative. They need to raise capital as a result for a business, which is ultimately a utility service with very poor financial returns.
subtitles.zh: 但近期财报显示自由现金流转负，需要融资，而该业务本质是公共服务，财务回报不佳。

subtitles.en: Yeah, that is an interesting one, and I wonder what sort of advice they got on the back of that, because I think, you know, into the results last week, the shared had performed relatively strongly, you know, it outperformed its peers.
subtitles.zh: 这很有趣，财报前股价表现相对强劲，跑赢同行。

subtitles.en: So maybe there was a judgment taken that, you know, there's good investment appetite. You know, clearly we've got very strong top-line growth in our cloud business. You know, we can tap investors in the equity markets for that.
subtitles.zh: 或许判断市场有配置意愿，云业务收入增长强劲，可通过股权市场融资。

subtitles.en: But yes, absolutely, it runs contrary to what's happening in the US at the moment. And for a business we're just sitting on in that cash position, why didn't they issue debt instead, assuming they could lock into, you know, an interesting rate.
subtitles.zh: 这与美国市场做法相反，既然有现金，为何不发债锁定利率？

subtitles.en: So, you know, potentially there's a bit of misjudgment on the market movement sentiment there, and we've seen these comments from Michael Barry as well, you know, which in his view that the stock's overvalued.
subtitles.zh: 可能对市场情绪判断有误，Michael Barry也认为估值偏高。

subtitles.en: So, you know, I think overall, this is all a big dent to sentiment to state the obvious given what's happening with the stock price at the moment. But the returns are just not there, you know, in pure financial terms, their AI strategy since they embarked on this path has been value-destructive.
subtitles.zh: 整体上，股价表现打击信心，从财务角度看，AI战略自启动以来在破坏价值。

title_highlights: 赢家却是经济与消费者

subtitles.en: Well, I think that's a question really for Michael Barry, but I think looking at the sector as a whole, you know, the market was very bullish on Chinatek through last autumn, and the sector consequently, a materially underperformed its global peers, and particularly its Asian peers.
subtitles.zh: 这问题该问Michael Barry，但整体看，去年秋市场对中国科技板块乐观，随后该板块明显跑输全球及亚洲同行。

subtitles.en: you know, the money was really in hardware, in tangible products as made by the likes of high-necks, TSMC. That's where you made the money as an investor.
subtitles.zh: 资金集中在硬件和实体产品，如台积电等，那是获利所在。

subtitles.en: So as a result of the underperformance, you know, Valley had emerged in Chinatek, including Alibaba. The question is, though, which of the companies is best position to deliver on that promise?
subtitles.zh: 由于跑输，中国科技板块出现估值洼地，包括阿里。问题是哪家公司最能兑现承诺？

subtitles.en: Because obviously, with companies like Moonshot and AI, there is strong technological progress in China, but as I've made the point multiple times, the market is flooded with supply, there are close to 1,000 competing large-language models.
subtitles.zh: 中国技术进展显著，但市场供给过剩，有近千个竞争的大语言模型。

subtitles.en: It's a commoditized sector, and the only way in which the companies are trying to monetize is through this effectively utility service token engines, which again, is very costly to build the infrastructure out. The returns you get on the back of that are relatively modest.
subtitles.zh: 这是同质化领域，变现方式主要是提供公共性质的token服务，但基础设施成本高，回报相对有限。

subtitles.en: It does support China's overall initiative to proliferate AI. So the winners are the economy, the winners are the consumer.
subtitles.zh: 这支持中国推广AI的整体倡议，最终受益的是经济和消费者。

大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一
